game_title: Loop Counter Conveyor – Echo Chamber Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Shadow Cave – Echo Chamber, a booming echo chamber: the spelunker must handle skeleton miners while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Echo Chamber: a booming echo chamber
core_gameplay_loop: In Echo Chamber, repeat each round: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed. Each round, skeleton miners strike the crystal door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the belt_count value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the crystal door from skeleton miners in Echo Chamber: keep the belt_count meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 36-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: belt_count drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 36-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Loop Counter Conveyor
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
